system.description:
● Stomping Ground: You know your domain (no more than a half dozen city blocks) like the back of your hand. Roll one more die any time you roll for any test related to local knowledge.

●●● My City: Cab drivers come to you for directions. In your domain (up to the size of a major city) you gain an automatic success in addition to your roll anytime you roll for a test related to local knowledge.
